extension.news: Version 0.1.0 Create Build captures a managed Kodi setup. Install Build applies a saved build to this device. Update / Repair checks the applied build for supported managed differences and repairs only the changes you review. Build Status, Settings and Help are in the native menu.
extension.summary: Capture and apply a managed Kodi setup.
Capture and apply a managed Kodi setup.
extension.description: Build Manager saves a managed Kodi setup as a build and applies it to your devices. Create Build captures a managed Kodi setup. Install Build applies a saved build. Update / Repair checks the applied build for supported managed differences and repairs only the changes you review. Build Status shows whether Kodi needs a restart or Build Manager needs your attention. Build Manager manages supported parts of a saved setup, not every Kodi file.
